title: Senior Data Analyst
status: Role still visible in Amber's micro1 portal; interview/application appears available
source: User-provided screenshots of micro1 role page on 2026-10-28
job_summary: Senior Data Analyst role supporting AI training, evaluation, and application to real-world data work. Emphasis on large business data sets, quality assurance, analytical precision, and PII handling.
key_responsibilities: Review data sets for PII and flag sensitive information using data privacy best practices
Assess AI responses to data and business-analysis scenarios and provide expert feedback
Apply QA practices to validate data quality, identify inconsistencies, and verify analytical results
Create objective evaluation frameworks and grading criteria for AI performance on analytical tasks
Collaborate with product and research teams to refine data, guidelines, and AI-driven analytics best practices
required_qualifications: Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, statistics, information systems, related field, or equivalent experience
3+ years as Business Analyst or Data Analyst working with large business data sets
Hands-on QA experience including data validation, reconciliation, and analytical-output verification
Expertise handling and analyzing large business data sets
Experience managing PII and sensitive material
preferred_qualifications: Advanced degree or professional certification in business analysis/data analytics
Prior AI, data labeling, or model evaluation exposure

fit_assessment.strategic_fit: Strong AI-transition side-project / portfolio bridge, but not a replacement for Amber's Senior Manager/Director career target
strongest_matches: Large-scale enterprise data analysis and reconciliation
Quality assurance, data validation, discrepancy detection, and controlled-change verification
Excel and Power BI / visualization experience
Current paid micro1 AI-training contract and prior AI evaluation exposure
fit_assessment.primary_gap_or_question: PII-specific handling should be substantiated carefully; do not overclaim privacy experience if evidence is limited
fit_assessment.secondary_question: SQL depth should be represented accurately; SQL is preferred rather than required

next_action: Interview after the Oct. 28 event if the portal remains open. Prepare examples around large-data QA/reconciliation, objective grading criteria, analytical validation, discrepancy triage, and any defensible PII/privacy handling experience. Create a targeted resume if the application flow requests or permits one.
